title: Intervention problems in the Linear Threshold Model: A general formulation and new results
summary: We study an optimal intervention problem for linear threshold models. This is a popular class of dynamical network systems whereby a number of agents, identified with the nodes of a graph, strategically change their binary action (0 or 1) according to a threshold rule. Specifically, an agent adopts action 1 if and only if the fraction of its neighbors in the interaction graph that do so is greater than or equal to a prescribed threshold.
